title: Squared Money Publishes The Home Improvement Index (2024-2025) | User | dailytimesleader.com
text:
The data provides valuable insights for anyone seeking home improvement loans in 2025.
Salford, UK , March 19, 2025 -- Loan specialist SquaredMoney.com has revealed the Home Improvement Index for 2024-25, highlighting the current climate surrounding home improvement projects in the UK.
Updated Data for 2024 Offers Homeowners the Most Relevant Insights
The Squared Money Home Improvement Index for 2024-25 by Squared Money shows that UK homeowners continue to invest heavily in home improvement projects with kitchen and bathroom remodels, loft conversions, and extensions considered the most popular solutions. It also highlights a growing interest in both eco-friendly and Smart technologies.
Designed to educate both homeowners and industry professionals alike, the updated report provides fresh insights by detailing ROIs, the median profit, and cost figures for a range of common UK home improvement projects. Moreover, the in-depth report covers both DIY and professional renovations, including traditional projects (kitchens, bathrooms, extensions) as well as emerging trends like garage conversions and sustainability-focused improvements.
The 2024-25 Home Improvement Index additionally features a side-by-side comparison with historical data (e.g., Zopa’s 2014/2016 reports), highlighting how market trends and consumer priorities have shifted over the past decade.
As the property market evolves and consumer habits change, the report helps readers make informed decisions amid current economic conditions and future market predictions. It even examines the impact of rising material and labour costs, evolving buyer expectations, and regulatory influences on ROI to provide a nuanced understanding of the current home improvement landscape.
In addition to valuable insights regarding the latest trends, the report offers valuable takeaways for homeowners on which improvements may yield the best returns, balancing direct financial benefits with broader lifestyle and long-term savings factors.
Whatever stage of the home improvement project planning process a reader is at, the data can help provide greater clarity to answer a wide range of questions. Whether it’s selecting a project that aligns with their long-term goals or identifying how much capital they need to borrow, the Home Improvement Index is a valuable research tool.
As well as providing accurate and relevant data, the Money Squared report presents information with clear visuals including charts, tables, and infographics. From understanding the current situation to comparing it to past data and future forecasting, the content is easily digested to promote calculated choices ahead of any planned project in 2025 and beyond.
The Home Improvement Index 2024-25 is available to view online via the Squared Money for free with immediate effect.
About Squared Money
Squared Money is a platform that helps consumers across the UK secure loans from £10k to £250k in just three easy steps. As well as facilitating a quick and simple process, the company offers bespoke solutions with competitive interest rates and no hidden fees. It additionally uses soft searches to protect applicants from adverse impacts on their credit profiles.
